Day Ray, along with his wife, 38-year-old Bumé, their younger son, 11-year-old Beau Ray, and two daughters, 8-year-old Christina Ray, and 2-year-old Ney May died from the injuries. The sole surviving 17-year-old Sha Rae suffered from a traumatic brain injury and spent between two to four days in the home without medical attention. And his first response to us is probably one of the most loving sentences I've ever heard in my life. And he says, but I still love him. He kept trying to wipe something off of his eyes. And it was a long after that where we shared the news with him about the new vision loss. that was a part of his life. He's been able to pull himself out of it and recognize that he's a living, walking miracle and there's a reason to live. To be able to relive and release with my whole classmates, teachers and principals, and move on from that life, I think it will be kind of, it'll just be nice. Religion is a big part of why I'm always so positive. It gets me thinking that I will be able to see my family again in the afterlife. My one major goal is to be happy and to make others happy. Becoming a true symbol of hope and triumph, Shaw graduated high school. I'm just so happy. I will be going to the University of Utah and majoring in pre-law. I wanted to be the inspirations to my siblings. I am very grateful. Tragedy struck in the following months. Last week, 19-year-old Chiray died unexpectedly Sunday in his aunt and uncle's home.
